title: Ukrainian Oat Pilaf with Oceanic Flavor
description: A hearty and flavorful pilaf dish from Ukraine, infused with the freshness of the ocean. Serve as a side or add your favorite protein for a complete meal.

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: You can also use other neutral oil for cooking

ingredients.name: Fresh dill
ingredients.notes: You can adjust the amount according to your taste

ingredients.name: Dried thyme
ingredients.notes: You can adjust the amount according to your taste

ingredients.name: Fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: You can adjust the amount according to your taste

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the oat and pilaf and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes.
Add the dried thyme, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the fresh dill, parsley, and lemon juice.
